topArticle.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
topArticle.description:
Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week 
Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations.
After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas.

topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ、野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドの帰国を歓迎
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドが亡命から帰国し、大規模な歓迎を受け、国の政治的未来への期待と疑問が高まっている。

topArticle.title: Beyond the beaches: The Dominican Republic and the global debate over deep-sea mining
topArticle.description: The DR wanted science to keep advancing and the International Seabed Authority to finish building the regulatory framework that the UN Convention had mandated it to develop.
topArticle.titleJa: ビーチを越えて：ドミニカ共和国と深海採掘を巡る世界的議論
topArticle.summary: ドミニカ共和国は科学の進歩と、国連海洋法条約で義務付けられた深海採掘規制枠組みの完成を国際海底機構に求めている。

topArticle.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
topArticle.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシア副大統領が辞任、与党連合に亀裂の兆候
topArticle.summary: インドネシア副大統領が辞任。プラボウォ大統領はジョコ・ウィドド前大統領との溝が深まり、政局が不安定化している。

topArticle.title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'
topArticle.description: The Tamil Nadu government has ordered an internal audit of library collections across the state.
topArticle.titleJa: インドの新たな巨大図書館、「AI生成本」スキャンダルに揺れる
topArticle.summary: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州の巨大図書館でAI生成本を巡るスキャンダルが発生し、州政府が調査を命令した。

topArticle.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
topArticle.description: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.
topArticle.titleJa: バングラデシュで暴力発生、失脚した首相の支持者が抗議活動
topArticle.summary: バングラデシュでシェイク・ハシナ元首相の支持者が抗議活動を行い、衝突が発生。支持者は彼女の帰国を求めている。

topArticle.title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
topArticle.description: The Odyssey was meant to take guests around the world for years, but the trip was cut short after its operator ran out of money.
topArticle.titleJa: シンガポールで「生涯クルーズ」船が差し押さえられる
topArticle.summary: 「オデッセイ」号は世界一周を予定していたが、運航会社の資金不足によりシンガポールで差し押さえられ、運航中止となった。

topArticle.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
topArticle.description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.
topArticle.titleJa: EU、一部のPET樹脂化学品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: EUは、一部のPET樹脂化学品の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
topArticle.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
topArticle.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：ベトナム
topArticle.summary: ベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回レビューが、WTO事務局とベトナム政府の報告書に基づき実施されます。

topArticle.title: Working Party chair visits Uzbekistan as WTO accession negotiations enter critical phase
topArticle.description: A WTO delegation led by Ambassador Sung-yo Choi of the Republic of Korea, chair of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan, visited Tashkent, Uzbekistan, from 1 to 3 November to support Uzbekistan's preparations for WTO accession as its negotiations enter a critical phase. The visit included high-level consultations with government officials on outstanding issues across the accession process and exchanges with international development partners and the academic community.
topArticle.titleJa: 作業部会議長、ウズベキスタン訪問：WTO加盟交渉が重要な局面へ
topArticle.summary: WTO作業部会議長がウズベキスタンを訪問し、WTO加盟交渉が重要な局面に入る中、準備を支援しました。
